votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt RDA Resolution 16 of 2021, amending the FY 2021-2022 final budget of the Redevelopment Agency, including relocation assistance to Utah Theater retail tenants ($116,000 from the Revolving Loan Fund), City Creek Daylighting Technical Analysis and Design Study ($105,000 from the North Temple Strategic Intervention Fund), and housekeeping adjustments to North Temple Strategic Intervention Fund ($2,043,252).
votes.description: Amends the RDA's FY 2021-22 final budget to fund retail tenant relocation assistance, a City Creek daylighting design study along the Folsom Trail, and housekeeping adjustments to the North Temple Strategic Intervention Fund.

votes.motion: Ratify the Chair's determination to meet remotely without an anchor location.
votes.description: Ratifies the Chair's decision to continue holding meetings remotely and without an anchor location due to health and safety concerns and the continued closure of the City and County Building to the public.

votes.motion: Adopt RDA Resolution 17 of 2021, authorizing a two-year property tax increment collection period extension for the Central Business District, North Temple, Depot District, and Granary District project areas.
votes.description: Extends the property tax increment collection period by two years for four RDA project areas pursuant to Senate Bill 6001 passed during the 2020 State Legislature special session, in response to the impacts of the COVID-19 pandemic.
